name: watchguard-mcp
description: WatchGuard Cloud's Firebox, FireCloud, Endpoint Security, ThreatSync, NDR, AuthPoint and account platform APIs in one CLI and MCP server, with cross-customer reports for Service Providers.

watchguard_client_id.title: WATCHGUARD_CLIENT_ID
watchguard_client_id.description: WatchGuard Cloud API Access ID (Administration > Managed Access). Use the read-only Access ID for a reporting-only setup.

watchguard_client_secret.title: WATCHGUARD_CLIENT_SECRET
watchguard_client_secret.description: The password you set for that Access ID when you enabled API access.

watchguard_api_key.title: WATCHGUARD_API_KEY
watchguard_api_key.description: WatchGuard Cloud API key, sent as the WatchGuard-API-Key header (Administration > Managed Access).

watchguard_account_id.title: WATCHGUARD_ACCOUNT_ID
watchguard_account_id.description: Your WatchGuard Cloud account ID (ACC-... or WGC-...). Requests default to this account; a Service Provider's cross-customer commands start from it.

watchguard_base_url.title: Region API base URL
watchguard_base_url.description: Leave blank for North America (https://api.usa.cloud.watchguard.com). EMEA: https://api.deu.cloud.watchguard.com. APAC: https://api.jpn.cloud.watchguard.com.

watchguard_token_url.title: Region token URL
watchguard_token_url.description: Leave blank for North America (https://api.usa.cloud.watchguard.com/oauth/token). For EMEA or APAC use your region's gateway with /oauth/token on the end.

watchguard_audience.title: Pin one managed account
watchguard_audience.description: Optional convenience. A managed account's audience value (watchguard-cli audiences --account-id <id> returns it) sends every request with that customer's token. Not a security boundary: WatchGuard's audience token also works on your own account. Leave blank for the cross-customer commands.

watchguard_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scope
watchguard_oauth_scope.description: Leave blank for the documented default api-access.

watchguard_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
watchguard_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

watchguard_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
watchguard_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 (true, yes or on also work) to drop the MCP server's write tools and refuse every non-GET call through watchguard_execute. Leave blank for the full tool set. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

watchguard_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
watchguard_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: there are no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which customer accounts a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, give it the read-only Access ID.
